descriptions.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Red Dawn' Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Red Dawn' is a spectacular hybrid full moon Japanese maple. It leafs out in the spring with a red to lavender rounded leaf. This Japanese maple has more lobes than most Acer palmatum, showing the Acer shirasawanum in its genetics. The seeds also point upward on this Japanese maple, another characteristic typical of a full moon maple. The gorgeous spring colors on this maple are simply amazing. Mid-summer an emerald cast may emerge in the leaf creating a nice two-tone effect. Fall color is a bright crimson red. This Japanese maple may reach 10-12 ft in height in 15 years with a canopy of equal size.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Red Dawn' 红叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。 'Red Dawn' 是一款非常精彩的杂交满月日本枫。 春季展叶时，叶片呈红至淡紫色，叶形圆整。 该品种的裂片数比多数 Acer palmatum 更多，体现出其遗传背景中的 Acer shirasawanum 特征。 其种子也向上着生，这也是满月枫常见的典型特征之一。 这株枫树春季叶色极为出众。 至仲夏时，叶片可能浮现祖母绿色调，形成漂亮的双色效果。 秋色为鲜艳的深红色。 该品种在 15 年内可长至约 10-12 英尺高，冠幅相近。
